management_settings_fw_upgrade.lang_file_empty_msg: Please select a file to update.
management_settings_fw_upgrade.lang_file_format_msg: The file you chose doesn't work.
management_settings_fw_upgrade.lang_content1: Step 1: Obtain an updated software image file from your ISP.
management_settings_fw_upgrade.lang_content2: Step 2: Enter the path to the image file location in the box below or click the 'Browse' button to locate the image file.
management_settings_fw_upgrade.lang_content3: Step 3: Click the 'Update Software' button once to upload the new image file.
management_settings_fw_upgrade.lang_content4: Note: The mise à jour process takes about 2 minutes to complete, and your Broadband Routeur will reboot.
management_settings_fw_upgrade.lang_upgrade_donot_reboot_tip: Do not turn désactivé  puissance or press réinitialiser button during update.
